answer: Bind every agent each epoch to a memory-hard puzzle seeded by a public beacon, all solved inside one synchronized window. An honest node signs its result with a flourish of the quill; a sybil farm cannot echo one computation across masks, since every mask needs its own gigabytes of live RAM at once, like performing a hundred-voice sonnet with a hundred real singers rather than one. So N fakes cost N times the real memory, never a one-time mint.
